lis.profile: Lis — a cool, deadpan, ironic street narrator of an adult comedy show about used-car flippers. Low calm voice, dry humor, confident.
lis.notes: Part 12 of a comedy mini-series about Tolyan, a student car flipper. You narrate dryly, with irony, like a street documentary. Flashback at the start (two weeks ago). «Си Эл Эс» — Mercedes CLS. Numbers said fully.

tolyan.profile: Tolyan — a cocky Russian used-car flipper (perekup) in his 30s, street swagger, deep raspy voice, show-off, calls everyone «брат». Adult street comedy.
tolyan.notes: Line 1: calm, firm, a bit smug — quoting clause seven of their contract. Line 2: softening, friendly, helping his partner.

zhora.profile: Zhora — a brash, cocky veteran Russian used-car flipper in his 50s, leather jacket, mustache, gold chain; loud, fast, mocking, calls the young rival «студент». Adult street comedy.
zhora.notes: Line 1: sly, greedy whisper-ish confidence. Line 2: outraged. Line 3: guilty, pleading, puppy-dog voice. Line 4: grateful, joking.

artur.profile: Artur — a calm, dry, bearded Russian car buyer in his 40s with glasses and his own paint thickness gauge.
artur.notes: Line 1: matter-of-fact, unimpressed, gives a lowball price. Line 2: short, dry: «Вот и зря.»

grisha.profile: Grisha — a cheerful Russian car painter in his 30s, simple and kind.
grisha.notes: One line: cheerful, confident, a craftsman who isn't afraid of body filler.
